prompts.prompt:
Create one production concept image for the Career World skill building "CI/CD". This is a compact supporting skill structure: highly detailed and distinctive, smaller than project landmarks and much smaller than city capitals. Research-grounded domain summary: A software delivery capability that responds to source changes with automated build, test, artifact production, staged promotion, deployment controls, feedback, and recoverable release paths. Accepted baseline identity: An elongated fabrication hall is wrapped by a continuous elevated service track and terminates in two sequential release bays with different roof heights.

Exploration 1 — Canonical Instrument: refine the accepted baseline into a precise compact technical instrument building. Specifically emphasize this researched quality: event-triggered integration. Do not draw arrows, pipeline diagrams, brand-specific runners, logos, code, or deployment dashboards. Make sequence and gates physically legible.

One isolated complete asset in exact orthographic 2.5D isometric perspective, viewed from above at a consistent three-quarter angle. Grayscale only: neutral black, white, and gray with no color tint. Dark near-black technical drafting background with a faint isometric grid. Restrained architectural wireframe line art, matte low-value faces, crisp traced edges, fine parallel construction lines, controlled dense detail, no glow. One image only: no second panel, thumbnails, inset, silhouette swatch, contact sheet, before/after, or detached props. Center the whole coherent structure with generous margin. All roofs, stairs, bridges, annexes, and masses must be buildable and physically connected. No words, letters, numbers, signage, logos, brand marks, UI, charts, arrows, people, vehicles, landscapes, photorealism, fantasy, or real-world facility resemblance.
